page.overview:
Who is Duck Diver?

Duck Diver is one of the Autobot Beastformers fighting a war on the planet Beest. His role in the Autobot Beastformer forces is "underwater probe" (reconnaissance) commander. He also holds the rank of Emperor of Lapol, the country on whose north beach he was born, under King Koala Gray.
